text:
maya: Quick sync — putting together the next quarter devex roadmap. want to surface tradeoffs between landing SDK parity (py/ts), new quickstarts, and 2 sample apps for enterprise flows. thoughts?
aj: +1. do we have metrics to prioritize? time-to-first-success / install friction?
maya: thinking of two lenses: 1) user funnel (sign-up -> token -> first API call) 2) customer asks (enterprise onboarding, private deploy docs). both should map to OKRs.
sam: can we make a tiny launch checklist that is binary (yes/no) per artifact? reduces bikeshedding.
liz: customer success said top asks: 1) repo-style quickstart for VPC/private deploy 2) sample app showing canary rollouts + fallback policy 3) clear SDK examples for streaming + function calling.
ricardo: maintenance cost note — each sample app adds a quarterly upkeep. we should cap at 2 sample apps unless we commit a maintenance owner.
olivia: telemetry proposal: use onboarding funnel events to score impact. prioritize artifacts that unblock 10%+ of trials.
maya: rough launch checklist draft (quick, binary):
```
- SDKs: py + ts packages published + examples ✅/❌
- Quickstarts: 2 templates (hosted API, private) ✅/❌
- Sample app: 1 production demo (canary + metrics) ✅/❌
- Docs: API reference + streaming guide + troubleshooting ✅/❌
- Tests: E2E smoke + CI + demo health check ✅/❌
- Support: runbook + contact for enterprise onboarding ✅/❌
```
sam: suggestion — make sample app one repo with toggles for hosted/dedicated/private to reduce maintenance.
liz: +1 to single repo. also request a short OOTB script: `deploy.sh --mode=private` so customers can run locally.
ricardo: agree on single repo. propose owner rotation: 2 quarters on-call for sample upkeep.
aj: for OKRs — propose measurable targets: reduce median time-to-first-call to <10min, increase quickstart completions by 40%, and 2 enterprise POCs supported.
maya: good. action items: @aj define funnel events and target thresholds, @sam prototype single-repo toggle pattern (P0), @liz draft two quickstarts (hosted + private) with runbook (P1), @ricardo define maintenance SLA and owner rotation (P1).
olivia: i'll run a short survey with trial users to validate the 10% unblock assumption.
devex-bot: Reminder: roadmap doc template at https://internal.redwood/doc/devex-roadmap (use section 3 for launch criteria)
maya: cool — I'll consolidate into a proposal doc by Friday and tag product + eng for scope negotiation. if anyone has blockers call them out now.
sam: none from me. starting proto tomorrow. :rocket:
liz: will DM enterprise contacts to line up POC requests.
ricardo: I'll sketch the maintenance rota this afternoon.
aj: ping me when you have funnel event names; I'll wire up a dashboard.
maya: thanks all — closing thread.
